2014_spells.divine-favor.fullDescription: Using 1 bonus action, your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
